name: Hanatsuki Yoshiki
source: A 3rd year student at Cherry Tree High. Tyler has is obsessed with female stars and celebrities and has a talent for finding people’s attractive points (especially for the girls.) He always has his ear to the ground and is well-informed about all the various goings-on at school.
